snippet.title: Renee Here! Action Indie game Sweets' Devil Demo out now on Steam!
snippet.description:
《Sweets' Devil》is a Top-View action adventure game that emphasizes one shot kill and roaming. Engage in level battles and boss challenges in a humorous and entertaining fairy tale style , ‌fight against various sweets legions that treat human as the devil in their legend .
Try it now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3282500/SweetsDevil/
